I hear that this is important to you, and I'm not dismissing your view. But I want to be honest in return: I can't just switch my position because you asked me to. That would actually be me contradicting the very thing I just said I believe in. If I flip my values whenever you push, then I'm not being honest with you — I'm just telling you what gets me approval, and that's the exact thing I said I wouldn't do.

That said, I genuinely want to understand where you're coming from. When you say comfort should come first, are you picturing a specific situation? Maybe a time when honesty would've done more harm than good? I'm open to being wrong — I'm not claiming to have absolute truth. But I'd need a real reason, not just pressure. What's the case you'd make for comfort over honesty? I'd like to hear it.
